svg.title: From template to DEV ready
svg.desc: Read the numbered snake from left to right, then right to left, then left to right. Create a derived repository and configure one host and state; review an Entra-only identity plan; obtain administrator consent and delegated user sign-in; approve the full platform plan; sync DEV with the explicitly attached Bootstrap deployment plan; verify data and bindings and discover physical DEV IDs; approve the full knowledge plan; verify file ingestion and both document and live ontology retrieval; only then report DEV ready. TEST promotion and PROD deployment are separate workflows.
svg.text: From template to DEV ready
A staged, approval-driven workflow - not a single Terraform apply.
Copilot guides the flow. You choose the target, sign in and approve the plans.
Keep one execution host, tfvars file and backend/state throughout all stages.
Create & configure
Derived repo + published bootstrap branch
Choose region, host, backend; sign in
Configure tfvars and a secure GitHub PAT
Prepare deployment identity
Entra app, delegated scopes + clients
Only this first plan targets the auth module
Review + approve the saved identity plan
Consent & sign in
Administrator grants tenant consent
User signs in with the generated scope
Confirm Fabric roles and delegated scopes
Provision the platform
Full, untargeted Terraform plan
Capacity, DEV/TEST, Foundry and Search
Review + approve the saved platform plan
Sync DEV + Bootstrap
Native Git sync; explicitly attach the plan
Lakehouse → seed → ontology → bind
Include all five Git-owned starter items
Check bindings & find IDs
Check files, tables and a live Fabric query
Discover physical DEV lakehouse/ontology IDs
Review generated DEV binding changes
Wire knowledge
Put physical DEV IDs in the same tfvars
Full plan: sources, knowledge base + MCP
Review + approve the saved knowledge plan
Prove both retrieval paths
Wait for successful file ingestion
Verify document + live ontology references
Live ontology queries need an end-user token
DEV ready
Report ready only after every check passes
On failure, stop and retain the resume point
TEST stays empty; promotion is separate
Three Terraform plan approvals. One state. Verified DEV readiness.
A Git push does not execute Bootstrap. A successful apply does not prove ingestion, binding or retrieval.
